name: lp-feature-tabs
description: Feature library: centred heading over pill tabs (CSS-only, no script) that switch between grids of checked features, each a title and a line of copy; three across on desktop, two on tablets, one on phones. With one tab the bar is left out and the grid shows alone. Live: the 'Explore all of our features' tabs (bs-tab-slider) on /solutions/asset-management-ot-ga/.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

tone.description: Section background: the soft grey band or white.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

tabs.description: Up to 8 tabs, in order; the first opens. Each: label (required) and items (list of { title (required), body }).
